question: Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).
sql:
-- Let me get rows 51-100
WITH pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap AS excluded_lap
    FROM pit_stops
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap + 1 AS excluded_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, TRY_CAST(CAST(lap AS VARCHAR) AS BIGINT) AS excluded_lap
    FROM retirements
),
excluded_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, excluded_lap FROM pit_stop_laps
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, excluded_lap FROM retirement_laps
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id,
        driver_id,
        lap,
        position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap >= 2
),
filtered_changes AS (
    SELECT pc.*
    FROM position_changes pc
    LEFT JOIN excluded_laps el ON pc.race_id = el.race_id AND pc.driver_id = el.driver_id AND pc.lap = el.excluded_lap
    WHERE el.excluded_lap IS NULL
),
driver_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS times_overtaken,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS times_overtaking
    FROM (
        SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, prev_position, position - prev_position AS pos_change
        FROM filtered_changes
        WHERE prev_position IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT de.full_name
FROM driver_stats ds
JOIN drivers_ext de ON ds.driver_id = de.driver_id
WHERE ds.times_overtaken > ds.times_overtaking
ORDER BY de.full_name
OFFSET 50

{"sql": "-- Now I need to understand the approach better.
-- For each driver in each race, I need to:
-- 1. Get consecutive lap positions (for lap >= 2, since lap 1 is excluded as first lap)
-- 2. Calculate the position change from previous lap
-- 3. Exclude position changes that are due to pit stops or retirements
-- 4. Count overtakes (position decreased) and overtaken (position increased)

WITH position_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id,
        driver_id,
        lap,
        position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions

FROM position_changes
WHERE prev_position IS NOT NULL

{"preview_rows": 50, "sql": "-- OK, full_name is in drivers_ext. Let me use that to get the full names
WITH pit_stop_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap AS excluded_lap
    FROM pit_stops
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap + 1 AS excluded_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
retirement_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, TRY_CAST(CAST(lap AS VARCHAR) AS BIGINT) AS excluded_lap
    FROM retirements
),
excluded_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, excluded_lap FROM pit_stop_laps
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, excluded_lap FROM retirement_laps
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id,
        driver_id,
        lap,
        position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap >= 2
),
filtered_changes AS (
    SELECT pc.*
    FROM position_changes pc
    LEFT JOIN excluded_laps el ON pc.race_id = el.race_id AND pc.driver_id = el.driver_id AND pc.lap = el.excluded_lap
    WHERE el.excluded_lap IS NULL
),
driver_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS times_overtaken,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS times_overtaking
    FROM (
        SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, prev_position, position - prev_position AS pos_change
        FROM filtered_changes
        WHERE prev_position IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT de.full_name
FROM driver_stats ds
JOIN drivers_ext de ON ds.driver_id = de.driver_id
WHERE ds.times_overtaken > ds.times_overtaking
ORDER BY de.full_name"}

    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap + 1 AS excluded_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
retirement_laps AS (

    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, excluded_lap FROM retirement_laps
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id,
        driver_id,
        lap,
        position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap >= 2
),
filtered_changes AS (
    SELECT pc.*
    FROM position_changes pc
    LEFT JOIN excluded_laps el ON pc.race_id = el.race_id AND pc.driver_id = el.driver_id AND pc.lap = el.excluded_lap
    WHERE el.excluded_lap IS NULL
),
driver_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS times_overtaken,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_change > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS times_overtaking
    FROM (
        SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, prev_position, position - prev_position AS pos_change
        FROM filtered_changes
        WHERE prev_position IS NOT NULL
